title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
subtitle: Chuck roast with potatoes, carrots and mushroom gravy
description: Seared chuck roast slow-cooked with potatoes and carrots under a creamy mushroom, onion and celery sauce that becomes a rich gravy.

imageCredit.author: jeffreyw
imageCredit.title: Mmm... garlicy beef pot roast and roasted veggies

steps.heading: Sear the Beef
steps.text: Pat the roast dry and season it with salt and pepper. Brown it in the hot oil over medium-high heat, about 3 minutes a side. Set it in the slow cooker with the potatoes and carrots tucked around it.

steps.heading: Brown the Vegetables
steps.text: In the same pan, melt the butter and cook the onion, celery and mushrooms about 5 minutes, until browned.

steps.heading: Build the Sauce
steps.text: Stir in the flour for a minute, then slowly whisk in the broth and milk until thickened. Add the Worcestershire and a little salt and pepper.

steps.heading: Slow Cook
steps.text: Pour the sauce over the roast, cover and cook on low about 8 hours, until fork-tender.

steps.heading: Rest
steps.text: Move the beef and vegetables to a platter and tent with foil.

steps.heading: Make the Gravy
steps.text: Pour the cooking liquid into a skillet over medium-high heat. Whisk the cornstarch with a little of the liquid, stir it back in and simmer about 10 minutes until thick. Serve over the roast.
